plausibility_notes: Ella now leads: she specifically removes a miniature from her pledge envelope beside the donor glass, and corrects an apparent late-arrival alibi to an early arrival before source theft. This creates source opportunity plus transfer-container opportunity. No statement identifies the waste miniature as hers, establishes pouring, or locates her at the cabinet.

Al remains strong: handled empty glass, had uncapped miniature at same desk. Fragrance stain on invoice establishes fragrance contact but does not exclude subsequent poison transfer, a different miniature, or mixed contents. His explicit acknowledgment that poison could enter empty glass makes this logical alternative unavoidable.

Brie self-reports stem/base wiping and returning favor to packet, which narrows admitted handling rather than proves it. Meal negatives do not clear targeted glass poisoning. Casey still has post-collection access.

Late admission/ticket receipts weaken theft opportunity for Hugh, Tess and Anya only if independently verified as first arrival, and only for a solo-theft theory. Ella explicitly distinguishes ticket collection from actual arrival, undercutting universal use of those receipts.

Most final speeches explain wrongdoing, threat semantics, or absence of legal benefit, not murder innocence. Unopened, capped, returned fragrance assertions are not forensic exclusion without seals and testing. Final Ella lead has an evidence basis but its uniqueness relies heavily on the author choosing who receives reassuring explanations.
No final reveal supplied and none assumed; unresolved competition remains substantial.
